questions.text: A triangle has sides \(13,14,15\). Find the largest angle.
Two sides of a triangle are \(20\) and \(21\), and the included angle is \(60^\circ\). Find the third side, then the area.
A triangle has sides \(25,25,30\). Find its area without using a calculator.
A hiker walks \(12\) km due east, then \(5\sqrt2\) km on a bearing \(N45^\circ E\). How far is the hiker from the starting point?
Point \(B\) is \(100\) miles from point \(A\) at bearing \(N60^\circ E\). A pilot mistakenly flies due east from \(A\) for \(50\) miles. How far is the pilot from \(B\)?
A triangle has sides \(29,29,42\). Find the exact value of \(\cos\theta\), where \(\theta\) is one of the base angles.

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.6 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q1
questions.text: In $\triangle ABC$, the measure of $\angle C$ is $60^\circ$. The side lengths $a$ and $b$ differ by exactly 3, and side $c$ has a length of 7. Determine the lengths of sides $a$ and $b$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.6 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q2
questions.text: A triangle has side lengths $13x$, $14x$, and $15x$ for some positive real number $x$. If its area is numerically equal to its semiperimeter, determine the exact value of $x$.

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.6 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q3
questions.text: In quadrilateral $ABCD$, the side lengths are $AB = 7$, $BC = 24$, $CD = 20$, and $DA = 15$. Given that $\angle ABC$ is exactly $90^\circ$, determine the measure of $\angle ADC$ without writing down any calculations.

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.6 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q4
questions.text: A ship leaves port and sails 40 miles at a bearing of $020^\circ$ (measured clockwise from due North). It then turns and sails another 40 miles at a bearing of $140^\circ$. What is the ship's exact straight-line distance from the port?

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.6 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q5
questions.text: The side lengths $a$, $b$, and $c$ of a triangle satisfy the algebraic relation $2(a^2b^2 + b^2c^2 + c^2a^2) - (a^4 + b^4 + c^4) = 576$. Mentally determine the area of the triangle.

questions.source_label: Chapter 5.6 / Olympiad Problems / Gemini 3.1 Pro / Q6
questions.text: The side lengths of an oblique triangle are given by the expressions $2x+1$, $x^2-1$, and $x^2+x+1$ for some integer $x > 1$. Determine the degree measure of the largest angle in this triangle.
